title: @pyqvault_ · Maths, visualised #4: six trig ratios = six real lines (copy of a 59× reel, af_heart voice)

captions.instagram:
Class 11 Maths · Trigonometric Functions
Maths, visualised #4

sin, cos, tan, sec, cot, cosec aren't just ratios. On a circle of radius 1, each one is a real line.
tan θ sits on the line that touches the circle: tangent = touching. sec θ is the slant that cuts through it: secant = to cut. The same at the top gives cot θ and cosec θ.
Pythagoras on those triangles gives 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.
On the syllabus for CBSE, JEE Main and MHT-CET.
